dialogue.content: （よろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for this session.)

dialogue.content: (よろしくお願いします。)
dialogue.English: (You too.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: こんばんは24才　女性彼氏とのことです。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm a 24-year-old woman. It's about my boyfriend.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。パートナーさんとのことでのご相談ですね。どのようなことでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Thank you. So you'd like to discuss something regarding your partner. Could you tell me more about it?

dialogue.content: はい付き合っていた彼と連絡が途絶えて一月たちます。向こうは合えないと言ったま、ラインの返事を返しません。
dialogue.English: Yes. It’s been a month since I lost contact with my boyfriend. He said he couldn’t meet, and since then he hasn’t replied to my LINE messages.

dialogue.content: それはご心配ですね。突然言われたのですか？
dialogue.English: That must be very worrying. Did he say that suddenly?

dialogue.content: 最近連絡が減ってきていて、合う回数も週一でしたが、一月会えていなくて、最後は別れるしかない、みたいにラインだいわれて。そういう話しはあってすべきですよね？
dialogue.English: His messages had been getting less frequent recently. We were meeting once a week, but we haven't seen each other for a month. Finally, he sent me a LINE message saying something like, "I guess we have no choice but to break up." That kind of conversation should be had in person, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね。そういう大切なお話は、会ってするものだと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I agree. I believe important conversations like that should be held in person.

dialogue.content: では最後はLINEで言われてそれっきりということでしょうか。
dialogue.English: So, he told you that over LINE, and that was the last you heard from him?

dialogue.content: そうですね。会いたい、会えない、というやり取りが何回か続き、それっきりです。もう、毎日生きている感覚さえなくなってきている感じです。
dialogue.English: That's right. We went back and forth a few times, with me saying, "I want to see you," and him saying, "I can't," and then that was it. Now, I feel like I've even lost the sense of being alive day to day.

dialogue.content: はじめは泣いたり怒ったりしていましたが…。
dialogue.English: At first, I cried and got angry, but...

dialogue.content: それは大変な思いをされましたね。最初はいろいろな思いが駆け巡って、今はその感覚もなくなってきている感じなのですね。
dialogue.English: You've been through so much. It sounds like you were flooded with all sorts of emotions at first, and now even that sensation is starting to fade.

dialogue.content: もう、訳がわからなくなって、考えるのもつらい。考える力も奪われた感じです。
dialogue.English: I just don't understand anything anymore, and it's painful to even think. It feels like my ability to think has been taken from me.

dialogue.content: 連絡したくてもお相手とつながらないと本当に辛いですよね。ではあなたは、パートナーさんとやり直したいと考えておられるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It must be so painful to want to contact him but not be able to connect. Are you hoping to get back together with your partner?

dialogue.content: はい、まずは何がこうなってしまったか聞きたいです。わからないのです。思い当たることがなくて、沢山考えても。それを知りたい。もし私が嫌いになったら、それでもいはいから、教えてほしい！
dialogue.English: Yes. First, I want to ask him what led to this. I don't understand. I can't think of any reason, no matter how much I think about it. I just want to know why. Even if he's come to dislike me, that's fine—I just want him to tell me!

dialogue.content: そうですか。なぜ会えない、別れたいと言われなければならないのか、心当たりもなくて、訳を知りたいのも無理ないですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's only natural that you want to know why he would say you can't meet or that he wants to break up, especially when you have no idea what the reason could be.

dialogue.content: パートナーさんとは、直接会うのとLINE以外に連絡を取り合う手段はあるのですか？
dialogue.English: Besides meeting in person or using LINE, are there any other ways you can contact your partner?

dialogue.content: 彼の仕事場だけは知っています。そこに行けば会える。でも、それは出来ない。
dialogue.English: I only know where he works. I could see him if I went there. But I can't do that.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。なかなか職場までいきなり直接行くというのは難しいですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It would be difficult to suddenly show up at his workplace.

dialogue.content: どんな顔をしているか、みるのが怖いです。
dialogue.English: I'm scared to see the look on his face.

dialogue.content: 知りたいことはあるし会いたいけど、実際に会ってどんな反応をされるのか考えると怖いですよね。
dialogue.English: You have things you want to know and you want to see him, but it's scary to think about how he might react if you actually meet in person.

dialogue.content: 拒否されている状態で。無理矢理は、出来ないかな。
dialogue.English: Since he's rejecting me... I don't think I can force things.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。あまり強引なことは出来ないですね。一つお聞きしたいのですが、パートナーさんと会ったり連絡を取ったりすることが減ってきたのは、急にだったのですか？
dialogue.English: You're right. It wouldn't be good to be too forceful. I'd like to ask one thing: did the decrease in meeting up and contacting your partner happen suddenly?

dialogue.content: はい、なんとなくラインの回数が減ってきて、彼からの内容がよそよそしくなってきていて。会う約束が予定が入ったと言われて、なんだかんだ、１ヶ月会えずになりました。そして連絡が途絶えました。
dialogue.English: Yes, the number of LINE messages just sort of decreased, and his messages became more distant. When we had plans to meet, he'd say something came up, and one thing led to another until we hadn't seen each other for a month. And then the contact stopped completely.

dialogue.content: そうですか。。パートナーさんは何らかの事情を知っていそうな感じですが、あなたはそれを知らないし知りたいから、混乱するし辛くなるのは無理ないですね。
dialogue.English: I see... It sounds like your partner might know the reason for this, but since you don't know and you want to know, it's only natural that you feel confused and hurt.

dialogue.content: たしかに、彼になにかあったのかもしれない。ただ私は知らない、知りたいけど知れない。ホントにつらいです。
dialogue.English: It's true, something might have happened to him. But I don't know, and I want to know but I can't find out. It's truly painful.

dialogue.content: 知りたいことがわからないのは、本当に辛いと思います。では、直接ではなく、間接的にパートナーさんの考えとか話を聞いたりすることは出来ますか？例えば共通のお友達とかお知り合いとかを通じてとか。
dialogue.English: Not being able to find out what you want to know must be truly painful. Is there any way you could indirectly hear about your partner's thoughts or what's going on? For example, through a mutual friend or acquaintance?

dialogue.content: 共通の知り合いはいました。でも、実はその人(私より3才年上)とも会う約束がドタキャンされ、それ以来連絡先とれていなくて。実は怖いんですその人と彼ができてしまったのではないかと。
dialogue.English: We had a mutual acquaintance. But actually, she (three years older than me) canceled our plans at the last minute, and I haven't been able to contact her since. To be honest, I'm scared that she and he might have gotten together.

dialogue.content: 共通のお知り合いは、女性の方なのですね。
dialogue.English: So, the mutual acquaintance is a woman, I see.

dialogue.content: はい。彼女、インフルエンザにかかってしまったと。必ず埋め合わせするね、というLINEを最後に連絡来なくなって。
dialogue.English: Yes. She said she came down with the flu. Her last LINE was, “I’ll definitely make it up to you,” and I haven’t heard from her since.

dialogue.content: でも、彼女は新婚なんです。だからまさかとも。
dialogue.English: But she's a newlywed. So I think to myself, 'surely not...'

dialogue.content: そうですか。インフルエンザにかかったと連絡が来たのは最近ですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Did she contact you about having the flu recently?

dialogue.content: 彼から会えないと言われたLINEが来たころです。
dialogue.English: It was around the same time I got the LINE message from him saying we couldn't meet.

dialogue.content: そうですか、同じ頃なのですね。ただ、お知り合いの方は既婚者ということになると、ご家族もいらっしゃいますし、インフルエンザはやはり治すのに時間がかかったりしますから、様々な理由が考えられますよね。
dialogue.English: I see, so it was around the same time. However, since your acquaintance is married, she has a family, and the flu can take a while to recover from, so there could be various reasons, couldn't there?

dialogue.content: メッセージを送っても既読スルーとかされてしまう感じなのですか？そのお知り合いの方とは。
dialogue.English: With that acquaintance, if you send messages, do they get left on read?

dialogue.content: 知り合いはまだ連絡こちらからはしてません。治ったらくれるのを待ってます。ある意味、怖いから連絡できないのかも。インフルエンザになってもう2週間たちます。回復しているはずなのに連絡きませんから。
dialogue.English: I haven't contacted her yet. I'm waiting for her to get in touch once she's better. In a way, maybe I can't contact her because I'm scared. It's been two weeks since she said she had the flu. She should have recovered by now, but I haven't heard from her.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。連絡をこちらからすることは出来るけど、やはり知りたいけど知るのが怖いという気持ちなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you could reach out to her, but you feel torn—you want to know, but you're also afraid of what you might find out.

dialogue.content: はい。そうなんです。やはり、二人は可能性ありそうですかね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's it. Do you think it's possible... that they're together?

dialogue.content: そうですね。。やはり実際に知ってみないと、可能性については何とも言いようがないのではないでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Well... I think it’s hard to say anything about the possibility without actually finding out.

dialogue.content: 怖い気持ちは本当によくわかるのですが、こちらだけで考えていても良い方向に行くかどうかもわからないと思いますし。
dialogue.English: I truly understand that you're scared, but I also think that just thinking about it on your own won't necessarily lead to a better outcome.

dialogue.content: 考えているだけでは。確かに何もなりませんよね…。
dialogue.English: Just thinking about it... you're right, that won't accomplish anything...

dialogue.content: もう。やはり、諦めるしかないのでしょうか。何もかも。
dialogue.English: So... do I have no choice but to give up? On everything?

dialogue.content: いや、諦めることはないと思いますよ。考えることも確かにすごく大切なことだと思いますが、
dialogue.English: No, I don't think you need to give up. Thinking things through is certainly very important, but...

dialogue.content: あなたの知りたいという気持ちと怖いという気持ちが葛藤している中で、少しでも知りたいという気持ちが続くのであれば、
dialogue.English: ...while you're struggling with this conflict between wanting to know and being afraid, if that desire to know continues, even just a little...

dialogue.content: 知るということも必要なのではないかとも思います。決して諦めるということではなくて。
dialogue.English: ...then I think that finding out might also be necessary. It's not about giving up at all.

dialogue.content: そうですね。もう少し、考えて、知るを選ぶなら、何ができるか考えてみます。
dialogue.English: You're right. I'll think about it a little more, and if I choose to find out, I'll consider what I can do.

dialogue.content: そうですね。それがいいと私も思います。今日はそろそろ終了時間となってしまいますので申し訳ないのですが、またそのことでも他のことでも、何かありましたらまたいつでもこちらにお越しください。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think that's a good idea. I'm sorry, but our time is almost up for today. Please feel free to come back anytime if you want to talk about this or anything else.

dialogue.content: はい、聞いていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for listening.

dialogue.content: こちらこそお話を聞かせていただき、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your story with me.

dialogue.content: では、終了させていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Well then, we’ll end here for today.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.
